question: Why did the error rate go up on 07 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: A new deployment of catalog v3.14 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: The deployment of catalog v3.14 introduced a new version of the service.
The new version of the service had a bug that caused NullPointerExceptions.
NullPointerExceptions led to a high error rate in the service.

contributing_factors.description: A configuration change to the catalog feature flag caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: The feature flag change enabled a new feature in the catalog.
The new feature was not fully tested and caused NullPointerExceptions.
NullPointerExceptions led to a high error rate in the service.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the error rate to spike.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume stayed about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in p95 latency caused the error rate to spike.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency stayed about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate spike was due to a sudden increase in traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume increased by 16%, but the error rate increased by 446%.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region us-east rose from 0.37% to 2.04% (+446%), with a change point at 2026-03-07T05:25:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.12).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (735 per 5 min before, 852 per 5 min after, +16%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (121 ms before, 120 ms after, -1%).
Deployed catalog v3.14 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R012; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Changed catalog feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in us-east (catalog, us-east; 3 min before the change; record R011; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
High error rate on catalog in us-east (catalog, us-east; 10 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.14) (catalog, us-east; 3 min after the change; record R013; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.14) (catalog, us-east; 8 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Roll back the catalog v3.14 deployment to revert the changes.
Disable the new_ui_flow feature flag to prevent the NullPointerExceptions.
Conduct a thorough regression testing of the catalog v3.14 version.
